## Summary of Findings

### 1. Create/Update/Delete Routes in `packages/server/src/routes/index.ts`

All routes are mounted under the `/api` prefix (from `index.ts`: `app.use('/api', routes)`). Auth note: `router.use(authMiddleware)` is applied after the `GET /files/:id` route, so everything below requires a JWT. `/users` routes additionally require the `admin` role.

**POST routes (22):**
- `POST /auth/login` — login (public)
- `POST /files/upload` — upload file (multer)
- `POST /users` — create user (admin)
- `POST /courts`, `POST /case-types`, `POST /announcement-types` — create lookups
- `POST /customers` — create customer
- `POST /cases` — create case
- `POST /sessions` — create court session
- `POST /case-documents`, `POST /session-documents`, `POST /announcement-documents`, `POST /customer-documents` — create documents
- `POST /announcements` — create legal announcement
- `POST /templates` — create document template
- `POST /fees` — create fee agreement
- `POST /fee-payments` — create fee payment
- `POST /expenses`, `POST /expense-documents` — create expense / expense doc
- `POST /tasks` — create task
- `POST /backup/create` — dump all collections to JSON download
- `POST /backup/restore` — restore collections from JSON

**PUT routes (18):**
- `PUT /auth/profile` — update own profile (name/avatar)
- `PUT /auth/password` — change own password
- `PUT /users/:id` — update user (admin)
- `PUT /users/:id/permissions` — update user permissions (admin)
- `PUT /lawyer-profile` — upsert lawyer profile
- `PUT /courts/:id`, `PUT /case-types/:id`, `PUT /announcement-types/:id`
- `PUT /customers/:id`, `PUT /cases/:id`, `PUT /sessions/:id`
- `PUT /announcements/:id`, `PUT /templates/:id`
- `PUT /fees/:id` — (also writes a `FeeHistory` record when totalAmount changes)
- `PUT /expenses/:id`
- `PUT /system-info/:key` — upsert key/value
- `PUT /backup/settings`
- `PUT /tasks/:id`

**DELETE routes (18):**
- `DELETE /users/:id`, `DELETE /courts/:id`, `DELETE /case-types/:id`, `DELETE /announcement-types/:id`
- `DELETE /customers/:id` (cascade)
- `DELETE /cases/:id` (cascade)
- `DELETE /sessions/:id`
- `DELETE /case-documents/:id`, `DELETE /session-documents/:id`, `DELETE /announcement-documents/:id`, `DELETE /customer-documents/:id`
- `DELETE /announcements/:id`, `DELETE /templates/:id`
- `DELETE /fees/:id` (cascade payments/history), `DELETE /fee-payments/:id`
- `DELETE /expenses/:id`, `DELETE /expense-documents/:id`
- `DELETE /tasks/:id`

### 2. Activity / Notification Model in `packages/server/src/models/index.ts`

**No stored Activity or Notification model exists.** The defined Mongoose models are: `LawyerProfile`, `Court`, `CaseType`, `AnnouncementType`, `Customer`, `Case`, `CaseSession`, `CaseDocument`, `SessionDocument`, `CaseAnnouncement`, `AnnouncementDocument`, `CustomerDocument`, `DocumentTemplate`, `FeeAgreement`, `FeePayment`, `FeeHistory`, `Expense`, `ExpenseDocument`, `SystemInfo`, `Task`, `User`.

The closest thing to "activity logging" is `FeeHistory` (records fee-total changes only). The `GET /notifications` route **computes notifications on the fly** from `CaseSession` (upcoming sessions) and `CaseAnnouncement` (unreceived announcements with upcoming session dates) — there is no persisted notification/activity-log collection. Note: `notifications` exists only as an entry in `MODULE_NAMES` (for permissions) and a sidebar menu item, not as a model.

### 3. `Layout.tsx` Header (`packages/renderer/src/components/Layout.tsx`)

The layout is an Ant Design `<AntLayout>` with a `<Sider>` (sticky, dark gradient sidebar containing the logo + nav `Menu`) and an inner `<AntLayout>` containing `<Header>` + `<Content>`.

The **`<Header>`** (sticky top, height 52, `justifyContent: 'space-between'`) has two groups:
- **Left side:** a collapse-toggle (`MenuFoldOutlined`/`MenuUnfoldOutlined`) and the current page label (via `findLabel(selectedKey)`).
- **Right side:** a `<Dropdown>` with the user's `<Avatar>` + name + a `<Tag>` showing the role (admin/lawyer/secretary). Menu items: Profile, Logout.

**Where a notification bell could go:** There is currently **no bell icon in the Header**. `BellOutlined` is imported but only used for the `/notifications` sidebar menu item. The natural placement for a notification bell is in the Header's right-side group — immediately **to the left of the user `<Dropdown>`** (between the page-label group and the user avatar). The Header uses `display: flex` with `gap: 12`, so an additional element slots in cleanly there.

### 4. `Notifications.tsx` (`packages/renderer/src/pages/Notifications.tsx`)

It's a read-only page that fetches `GET /api/notifications` and displays:
- A `PageHeader` ("التنبيهات" / "Upcoming sessions and announcements needing follow-up").
- Three stat `<Card>`s: high / medium / low urgency counts (computed client-side from the returned array).
- An Ant `<Table>` with columns: type icon (`CalendarOutlined` for session / `NotificationOutlined` for announcement), title, description, date, case number, court name, and an urgency `<Tag>` (red/orange/blue). Paginated at 10/empty-state "لا توجد تنبيهات حالياً".

It performs **no create/update/delete** — purely a computed view. The data is derived server-side from sessions + announcements, so it's not stored.

### 5. WebSocket Setup

**There is no WebSocket / socket.io setup anywhere in the application code.**

- `packages/server/package.json` dependencies: `bcryptjs`, `cors`, `dotenv`, `express`, `gridfs-stream`, `jsonwebtoken`, `mongoose`, `multer`, `pdfkit`. **No `socket.io` or `ws`.**
- `packages/renderer/package.json` dependencies: `@ant-design/icons`, `antd`, `axios`, `dayjs`, `react`, `react-dom`, `react-router-dom`, `zustand`. **No socket client.**
- `packages/server/src/index.ts` uses a plain `app.listen(PORT)` Express HTTP server — no `http.Server` upgrade, no socket server attached.
- Searching actual source (`packages/server/src`, `packages/main/src`, `packages/renderer/src`) found **zero** socket/websocket imports. The only "socket" hit is `socketTimeoutMS: 30000` in `packages/server/src/config/database.ts` (a Mongoose connection option, unrelated).
- All the ~250 WebSocket matches in the broad search came from `node_modules` (Vite's HMR client and the bundled `ws` library inside Vite) — these are dev-tooling internals, not app runtime code.

The app is purely request/response (Axios → Express). Adding real-time notifications would require introducing a socket library (e.g., `socket.io`) on the server, attaching it to the existing HTTP server in `index.ts`, and a client in the renderer.
